-Knight's Armor- Safety rule #1: Wear armor to protect your flesh.
-Crimson Armor- You won't believe how slimming this tough armor is.
-Super Sharp Sword- Swing it towards your foe. Haven't won yet? Repeat previous step.
-Shield of Protection- Place it in front of anything dangerous. It's as simple as that.
-Shield of Vengeance- Sends projectiles back where they came from. That's mean.
-Ring of Speed- Allows you to dash because walking is slow and boring.
-Ring of Blazes- Simple dash isn't cool enough? How about a trail of flames?
-Arcane Wand- Point at your target. Shoot magic bolts. Try not to miss.
-Hercules Belt- Now you can move heavy things and open jars with bare hands!
-Mystic Orb- Ought to teleport to other worlds. But teleports to other rooms.
-Ghost Amulet- Makes you invulnerable! But only after you were hurt...
-Big Red Potion- Improves health. No side effects known.
-Vibrant Blue Elixir- Increases magic potency as expected.
-Golden Key- Obviously, opens a door with a golden lock.
